guidance_capabilities.note: Explicit execution declaration transcribed from this card's authored guidance field. False means this profile does not enable the capability; it is not evidence of equipment absence. guidance: inertial with midcourse datalink updates, terminal active radar homing

mass_kg.note: '≤210 kg (PL-15E)': its export version's, at most

range_km.note: '150-200 km (PL-15)'; the Chinese article gives 200-300 km

power_up_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

power_down_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

warhead_kg.note: no official figure: the press's estimate of 20 - 25 kg (Overt Defense, 2025), its middle - an estimate

explosive_kg.note: no source gives its charge: 37 % of its warhead, the median share of the game reference's charges (War Thunder's) - an estimate

gurney_kms.note: no source names its explosive: as PBXN-110, a modern HMX-based fill - an estimate

drag_area_m2.note: the isolated store's CD S below Mach 0.8 at a Reynolds number of 1e7 per metre, built up from its design (hangar storedrag.py: Hoerner's body of revolution 0.00472, its base 0.00157, its fins' friction 0.00093 m^2): an estimate by one method for every store

munk_volume_m3.note: its body's unstable moment across a flow, q x this x sin(2 x angle) (Munk, NACA Report 184): its volume 0.1200 m^3 from its design, times Lamb's k2 - k1 = 0.984 for its fineness 19.7 (hangar storedrag.py): an estimate by one method for every store

side_slope_m2.note: its fins' and base's force across it per radian of crossflow, over the dynamic pressure (hangar storedrag.py: one fin pair's Helmbold slope carried onto the body, slender-body theory's base): an estimate by one method for every store

side_arm_m.note: where that force acts, behind the store's CG (hangar storedrag.py: its fins' quarter chords, its base)
